{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "csSup_le",
      "informal_name": "Supremum Upper Bound in Conditionally Complete Lattices",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, s.Nonempty → (∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a) → sSup s ≤ a",
      "informal_description": "In a conditionally complete lattice, if a non-empty set $ s $ is bounded above by an element $ a $, then the supremum of $ s $ satisfies $ \\sup s \\leq a $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "ConditionallyCompleteLattice.csSup_le",
      "informal_name": "Supremum is the Least Upper Bound in Conditionally Complete Lattices",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_5} [self : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (s : Set α) (a : α),\n  s.Nonempty → a ∈ upperBounds s → sSup s ≤ a",
      "informal_description": "For any non-empty set $ s $ in a conditionally complete lattice $ \\alpha $, if $ a $ is an upper bound of $ s $, then the supremum of $ s $ satisfies $ \\sup s \\leq a $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Defs"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "csSup_le'",
      "informal_name": "Supremum is Less Than or Equal to Any Upper Bound",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, a ∈ upperBounds s → sSup s ≤ a",
      "informal_description": "For any set $ S $ in a conditionally complete lattice $ \\alpha $, if $ a $ is an upper bound of $ S $, then the supremum of $ S $ satisfies $ \\sup S \\leq a $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "csSup_le_iff",
      "informal_name": "Supremum Upper Bound Characterization",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {a : α},\n  BddAbove s → s.Nonempty → (sSup s ≤ a ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a)",
      "informal_description": "For a non-empty and bounded above set $ S $ in a conditionally complete lattice, the supremum of $ S $ satisfies $ \\sup S \\leq a $ if and only if every element $ b \\in S $ satisfies $ b \\leq a $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "le_csSup",
      "informal_name": "Supremum Upper Bound Property",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, BddAbove s → a ∈ s → a ≤ sSup s",
      "informal_description": "In a conditionally complete lattice $\\alpha$, if a set $s$ is non-empty and bounded above, then every element $a \\in s$ satisfies $a \\leq \\sup s$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Basic"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_name: Supremum Upper Bound in Conditionally Complete Lattices
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, s.Nonempty → (∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a) → sSup s ≤ a
items.informal_description: In a conditionally complete lattice, if a non-empty set $ s $ is bounded above by an element $ a $, then the supremum of $ s $ satisfies $ \sup s \leq a $.

items.informal_name: Supremum is the Least Upper Bound in Conditionally Complete Lattices
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_5} [self : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (s : Set α) (a : α),
  s.Nonempty → a ∈ upperBounds s → sSup s ≤ a
items.informal_description: For any non-empty set $ s $ in a conditionally complete lattice $ \alpha $, if $ a $ is an upper bound of $ s $, then the supremum of $ s $ satisfies $ \sup s \leq a $.

items.informal_name: Supremum is Less Than or Equal to Any Upper Bound
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, a ∈ upperBounds s → sSup s ≤ a
items.informal_description: For any set $ S $ in a conditionally complete lattice $ \alpha $, if $ a $ is an upper bound of $ S $, then the supremum of $ S $ satisfies $ \sup S \leq a $.

items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {a : α},
  BddAbove s → s.Nonempty → (sSup s ≤ a ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a)
items.informal_description: For a non-empty and bounded above set $ S $ in a conditionally complete lattice, the supremum of $ S $ satisfies $ \sup S \leq a $ if and only if every element $ b \in S $ satisfies $ b \leq a $.

items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, BddAbove s → a ∈ s → a ≤ sSup s
items.informal_description: In a conditionally complete lattice $\alpha$, if a set $s$ is non-empty and bounded above, then every element $a \in s$ satisfies $a \leq \sup s$.
